title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Member Terms: Activation of an Enrollment
content:
**Term 1. When an enrollment activates.** A PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) enrollment is activated when the member's signed PrePay Power agreement is on file (a prepay request of the enrollment agreement type in member-confirmed status) and an activation payment of at least the tier's activation payment minimum has posted. Both are read from the cooperative's records for that enrollment.

**Term 2. Activation window.** Activation may take place only within the tier's activation window (14 calendar days on every tier) after the enrollment was taken. Calendar days are counted from the day after the enrolled date, the last day of the window being the last day of the count; activation on that last day is still within the window.

**Term 3. The activation payment.** The activation payment is credited in full to the prepaid balance and no recovery portion is taken from it, so it is recorded as a payment from which no recovery applies.

**Term 4. Lapse.** An enrollment not activated within the window lapses and is closed, and the transferred arrears and any deposit credit are reversed back onto the service account by the billing department.

**Term 5. Start of daily billing.** Daily billing starts on the activated date.

### Condition, judgement, result

| Agreement on file and member-confirmed | Activation payment of at least the tier minimum posted | Within the window | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | activated |
| no | yes or no | yes | not activated |
| yes | no | yes | not activated |
| yes or no | yes or no | no (window passed) | lapses and is closed |

### Boundary case (hypothetical dates)

Enrollment taken on 10 April. Day 1 of the window is 11 April and day 14 is 24 April: an activation on 24 April is within the window; on 25 April the window has passed.
